record.source_text: Similarly, amounts for which the reclaim of refunded income tax (wage tax) is waived pursuant to Section 108(7)(2) may not be taken into account as special expenses under subsection (1)(3), b) Subsection (1)(3) shall also apply if, within the group of persons referred to in point 1, the lender or loan debtor on the one hand and the developer (owner) or housing applicant (beneficiary, tenant) on the other hand are not identical. 4. a) Young shares within the meaning of subsection (1)(4) are shares, aa) which are acquired upon formation for cash payment with immediate full payment of the issue amount (par value and premium) within three months of the entry of the company in the commercial register, bb) which are newly issued in the course of a capital increase for cash payment with immediate full payment of the issue amount (par value and premium) and which, in the course of an ordinary or authorised capital increase, are acquired within three months of the entry of the implementation of the increase of the share capital in the commercial register, or where, in the course of a contingent capital increase, the exercise of the irrevocable subscription right is declared.
